bilgiler: When the head turns left, the left lateral canal is stimulated.
The right abducens nucleus turns the right eye to the right.
Interneurons in the MLF contract the left medial rectus; both eyes turn together.

cumleler: How do both eyes turn together when you turn your head?
When the head turns left, the left lateral semicircular canal is stimulated.
Left vestibular nuclei excite the right abducens, turning the right eye right.
Interneurons ascend in the medial longitudinal fasciculus, or MLF.
They contract the left medial rectus, so both eyes turn right.
Because the eyes move opposite the head, the target stays in place.
